guidance: Internal callback: only an eligible active search Invocation may call search/browser. A parent conversation must use search/run for registered candidate search instead. Use its returned response_path with the bounded product search script; never invent or rewrite it. Do not retry this callback unchanged or change permissions.
summary: Internal callback for an active search Invocation only.

guidance: In a conversation, use search/run with request={"query":"...","profile":"browser","limit":20} for browser-backed candidate collection. Product search Invocations use the managed embedded browser through the scoped native callback. Other searches follow the configured provider order. Use purpose (why), query (actual terms). search/browser is an internal callback for an eligible active search Invocation, not a conversation entry.
